name: workspace
description: Hive is a local-first AI Wiki compiler for macOS. It is not a RAG app that rediscovers raw chunks on every question. Field sources remain immutable evidence; Hive incrementally compiles them into an AI-maintained Colony, keeps that Colony consistent, and exposes the shape of the compiled knowledge through The Hive graph.

scripts.test: echo "Use swift/xcode test commands from runbook"
scripts.impeccable:detect: npx impeccable detect Sources docs PRODUCT.md DESIGN.md --json
scripts.impeccable:polish: npx impeccable polish Sources docs PRODUCT.md DESIGN.md
